fusions.name: Quiet Ripple
fusions.desc: Hooks the target from up to 4 tiles away: it deals 26 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach, and always lands as a critical hit. The target moves 30% slower for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Hiss and Spit
fusions.desc: Spits a cone of water 2.5 tiles deep that deals 3 damage, with a 35% chance to leave each enemy [Leaden] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Paw on the Surface
fusions.desc: Draws up to 3 enemies within 5 tiles onto you for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Unruffled Fur
fusions.desc: The moment you are back at full health, your critical hit chance rises by 25% for your next strike. Once every 12 seconds.
